scope: Group-by-group Word ribbon comparison with the Office 365 web ribbon table

ribbon.macrosReason: Word for the web does not execute VBA macros; the button stays disabled with a reason instead of simulating behavior

gapClose: Insert > Links: added Table of Contents (Insert tab, matching Word web)
Layout > Page Background: added Page Color and Page Borders (matching Word web Layout tab)
Review > Comments: added Show Comments and Filter (All/Unresolved/Resolved)
Review > Tracking: added Accept/Reject and Move to Previous/Next
View > Page Movement: added Separate Pages and Switch Background
implemented: Mailings: client-side mail merge from CSV/XLSX; recipient selection/find/select-all; MERGEFIELD insert; address block; greeting line; NEXT and IF rules; preview; finish merge with page break per record; labels grid; envelopes target
References > Index: XE mark entry; index generation with page numbers from real pagination; update and clear; IndexHeading/Index1 styles round-trip
References > TOC: remove/rebuild with TOCHeading/TOC1..3 styles and real page numbers from pagination

Layout > Arrange: wp:anchor floating objects; position presets and offsets; wrap square/tight/through/topAndBottom/behind/front; align; rotate via a:xfrm rot; bring forward/send backward; selection pane with visibility; group/ungroup persisted in customXml/arrange.xml
Home: checklist toggle, paragraph borders (w:pBdr), paragraph options panel (line spacing + indent)
Insert: named emoji picker (emoji inserted as document text, UI labels are text-only)
Review: Mark All as Read with per-thread read indicator; comment filter
View: Header & Footer, Footnotes, Endnotes, Separate Pages, Switch Background, Zoom 100%
Nested tables: w:tbl is kept as WordNestedTable inside the parent cell; word count, pagination, mail merge and rendering recurse into it
Arrange grouping: real wpg:wgp group with child shapes; ungroup splits back into individual wp:anchor runs
Page-level exclusion plan places topAndBottom at its exact y (spacer + flow block) and multiple wrap floats at independent y; mail merge NEXT advances at run level
gating: Wrap panel states that square/tight/through wraps reflow body text while behind/front remain overlays and topAndBottom occupies flow at its exact y
TOC page numbers now use real pagination instead of the previous sequential placeholder

newChecks: word sdt + anchor link + nested table
word mail merge NEXT inside paragraph
word NEXT inside paragraph save round-trip

limitations: VBA macros cannot run in the browser (same as Word for the web)
